artworks.prompt: Real photograph: a classic red-and-white striped paper popcorn box overflowing with popcorn, in darkness, lit warmly from the front as if by a cinema screen. No shadow, no table.

Real photograph: a pair of vintage paper cinema admit-one tickets in cream and red, joined at a perforated edge, slightly curled, floating in darkness, warm front light. Blank (no readable text). No shadow.
Photographic, high detail, natural, like a crisp telephoto nature photograph: a pale moth fluttering in darkness, its wings lit warm gold as if crossing a projector beam. No beam visible. No shadow.
Real photograph: a heavy gold rope curtain tie-back with a big gold tassel, hanging from the top edge in darkness, warm theatre light. No curtain. No shadow.
